strings.name: David Ricks
strings.role: Pharmaceutical executive · Lilly chair and CEO
strings.summary: Ricks entered Lilly through business development and led Canadian, Chinese, US and Bio-Medicines operations before becoming CEO and chair in 2017. During his tenure Lilly expanded diabetes, obesity and neurological research and manufacturing, launching tirzepatide products and securing US approval of oral Foundayo in 2026. Medicines result from scientific teams, clinical work and partnerships.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Lilly, advancing research, development and production of medicines for diabetes, obesity and neurological disease.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in 1967 in the United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Medicines and research
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led corporate research and production across diabetes, obesity and neurological disease.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Manufacturing and supply
strings.highlights.h2.text: Managed capacity and global commercial operations during product expansion, with medicines developed by scientific teams, clinical work and partners.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Foundayo approved
strings.timeline.t1.text: FDA approved Lilly’s oral orforglipron for long-term weight management in specified adults.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Zepbound approved
strings.timeline.t2.text: FDA approved tirzepatide for chronic weight management in specified adults as Zepbound.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Mounjaro approved
strings.timeline.t3.text: FDA approved tirzepatide as Mounjaro for adults with type 2 diabetes.
strings.timeline.t4.title: CEO and chair
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became CEO in January and board chair in June.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Bio-Medicines leadership
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became president of Lilly Bio-Medicines with global responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Lilly USA president
strings.timeline.t6.text: Advanced from leadership of China operations to president of Lilly USA.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined Lilly
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined business development after his MBA, later moving into international management.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Purdue bachelor’s
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed undergraduate study, followed by business work and graduate education.
